    Corollary 10.5 for A₀, given Proposition 10.3 #

    cor:zero-supported-coverage for the ray system of A₀ with the dual weights (Char2A0.Cor105): the hypotheses of Theorem 9.1(3) come from the induction hypothesis of Proposition 8.3 through Lemma 9.2 (hWl_of_liftBelow), and the only remaining input is Proposition 10.3 in coefficients (IStar).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RaySys.Sys.integralPartialLifting {V R L : Type} [AddCommGroup L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] (S : Sys V R L) (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (hfin : IsRepresentationFinite k (↥(S.P.Lin k))ᵐᵒᵖ) {χ : L} (hχ : 0 < S.P.deg χ) (hprim : Prim χ) (hLB : LiftBelow k (Fintype.card R)) {d : R → ZMod 2} (hd : S.IsSol χ d) :
    ∃ (D : R → ℤ), S.IsSol χ D ∧ ∀ (r : R), ↑(D r) = d r

    Theorem 9.1 (thm:integral-partial-lifting): if the lifting assertion of Proposition 8.2 holds for every table with representation-finite linearization and fewer than dim A₀ rays, every solution modulo two of the Leibniz equations lifts to an integer solution (and hence to ℤ/4).
